hero.title: Assess candidates, not their resumes.
hero.subtitle: You ask your questions on camera. Every candidate answers whenever and wherever they want. Interw scores each interview against your criteria and surfaces the profiles worth seeing first.
hero.freeNote: Free · 15 interviews / month · no card required

problem.title: You're not sorting candidates today. You're sorting documents.
problem.outro: Everyone else, you never even heard.

s1.title: Applications come in.
s1.desc: All written with the same AI, all neatly calibrated, all convincing. Nothing sets them apart anymore.

s2.title: You sort on what shows.
s2.desc: The school, the years, the layout. Signals that don't tell you who will actually be best in the role.

s3.title: You call the survivors.
s3.desc: Fifteen minutes each, squeezed into your office hours and their availability. Most of the time, one minute is enough to decide.

s4.title: You meet three of them.
s4.desc: The only ones you truly listened to.

product.title: Interview everyone. Without losing your week.
product.desc: The AI transcribes every interview and matches it against your questions and your criteria. The best profiles rise to the top — including the ones a resume would have made you miss.

s1.title: Your questions, asked by you.
s1.desc: You describe the role, you choose your criteria, you film your questions. Ten minutes, once. The link is ready.

s2.title: Every candidate interviews on video
s2.desc: Wherever they feel comfortable, whenever it suits them: at home, between two meetings, in the evening after work. No slot to coordinate — they watch you ask your questions and answer at their own pace.

s3.title: The right profiles rise, you decide.
s3.desc: Our AI scores against your criteria, and every rating is backed by the answer excerpts that justify it. Watch ten seconds, two minutes or the whole interview — the call is yours.
s3.alt: Candidate list ranked by fit score

closing.title: What if your next hire is the one you would have ruled out on paper?

hero.title: A tool to hire better, faster, while giving everyone a fair shot.
hero.subtitle: Asynchronous video interviews, detailed reports, reusable resources. A platform built for teams who want to assess candidates, not their resumes.

meta.title: Product — Interw
meta.description: Discover Interw: asynchronous video interviews, detailed AI reports, reusable question and criteria libraries. A complete platform to assess candidates without bias.

dashboard.title: See everything at a glance
dashboard.desc: All your roles, your most promising candidates and your pending decisions on a single screen.
dashboard.b1: Active roles, completed sessions and average score
dashboard.b2: Top candidates from the last 30 days highlighted
dashboard.b3: Candidates to review so no profile slips through

projects.title: One role, your questions, your criteria
projects.desc: Create a role in under 10 minutes. Choose your questions, define your criteria, share the link with candidates who answer whenever they want.
projects.b1: A unique candidate link, shareable by email or social media
projects.b2: Progress tracking per role and per candidate

tracking.title: Watch every interview, shortlist in a few clicks
tracking.desc: All video answers, scored by the AI against your criteria. You rank each candidate: to discuss, shortlisted, meeting, yes or no — without ever leaving the page.
tracking.b1: Videos, AI scores and decisions in one view
tracking.b2: Quick filters: to review, to discuss, shortlisted
tracking.b3: Recruiter notes to share your view with the team

report.title: A detailed report for every candidate
report.desc: The AI transcribes and analyzes the interview against the criteria you defined. It then produces an analysis of the candidate's delivery and presence, plus a Big Five personality score.
report.b1: Role fit score and a one-sentence summary
report.b2: Criterion-by-criterion assessment with a level (Excellent, Partial, Missing)
report.b3: Exact candidate quotes with video timestamps

resources.title: Your questions and criteria, ready to reuse
resources.desc: Build your library over time. Reuse the questions that work across every role and build on what proves effective.
resources.b1: Questions organized by type (written, video, puzzle…)
resources.b2: Criteria reusable across all your roles

criteria.title: Your criteria, your method — not a generic grid
criteria.desc: Define exactly what you're looking for: soft skills, motivation, clarity of speech, job-specific skills. The AI assesses each candidate strictly against your criteria.
criteria.b2: Detailed descriptions to guide the AI analysis
criteria.b3: Same criteria, same rules for every candidate
